method: 95 real 2023-24 FC24-rated fixtures (no red cards), stratified by FC team OVR gap; real home/away kept; both sides 4-3-3 balanced normal; one deterministic seed per fixture; FC24 player attributes via tests/tools/fc-fixtures.mjs. keeperFlat72 = same inputs with both starting keepers reflexes/handling/oneOnOnes/aerialReach/command set to 72 (diagnostic only).
limits: 16 matches per league bin, 12/3 for cup bins; engine has no home advantage; fixed tactics; FC proxies are not FM CA; reference has no possession/pass data, Wyscout PL 2017/18 used for passing context.
